newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's Noel in strategic partnership.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's Noel in strategic partnership.

text.p: Industrias Alimenticias Noel SA, Colombia's largest processed food company in terms of sales, said it had entered into a strategic parnership with Spain's giant Chupa Chups confectioner to manufacture its hard candy in Colombia.

Noel said in a statement that its joint investment accord with Chupa Chups called for the construction of a $23 million manufacturing plant in Colombia's northwest province of Antioquia. The high-tech plant, coupled with Noel's distribution and marketing skills, should allow the two companies to grab a 25 percent share of the Andean region's hard candy market over the medium-term, the statement said.
Noel belongs to Colombia's powerful and highly diversified Sindicato Antioqueno conglomerate. It local stock has rallied 67 percent in U.S. dollar terms so far this year.
Santander Investment said earlier this week that it had initiated coverage of the company with a market perform rating, based on its belief that Noel's shares had little additional upside remaining.
Noel's stock was up 1.11 percent in trading late Thursday, however, at 5,450 pesos per share.
